offering_description.value: Provides automated traffic enforcement cameras and toll and violation processing for government agencies and rental car and fleet operators. It installs and runs camera and tolling systems, then processes citations, tolls and payments for customers.

primary_products.value: traffic enforcement cameras; toll transponders; parking enforcement systems

primary_services.value: toll and violation processing; citation management; rental car toll billing; camera system operation

customer_segment.value: B2G: city and county governments, state transportation agencies, toll authorities; B2B: car rental companies, fleet operators, commercial vehicle owners

end_markets.value: transportation; government; car rental; fleet management

revenue_model.value: service fees: fees for processing violations, tolls and citations for customers; transaction or usage fees: per-violation or per-toll fees charged on processed transactions; project or contract: multi-year contracts to operate camera and tolling programs; product sales: sales or leases of enforcement cameras and transponders
revenue_model.category: service fees; transaction or usage fees; project or contract; product sales

value_chain_position.value: service provider: runs enforcement and violation programs, sold to government agencies and fleet operators; software / platform: back-office platform for processing violations, tolls and payments

geography_served.value: global: US nationwide, plus operations in Europe, Australia and Latin America

specialization.value: related lines: traffic enforcement cameras, tolling, parking enforcement, rental car toll billing

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct contracts with government agencies and rental car companies; online: online payment portals for drivers paying citations and tolls

regulatory_exposure.value: high: automated enforcement and tolling regulated by state and local laws, municipal ordinances and privacy rules

notes: Geographic footprint outside the US and exact product mix are uncertain.
